title: No-Bake Matcha Pistachio Bliss Balls
hookLine: Clean-energy matcha pistachio bliss truffles sweetened with Medjool dates—ready in 8 mins.

items.name: Pitted soft dates + 2 tbsp coconut cream

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {mb_nut} and {mb_dat} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Pulse Together & Roll Emerald Truffles
steps.instructionTemplate: Pulse {mb_nut}, {mb_dat}, and {mb_mat} until sticky dough forms, roll into 10 emerald truffles, and chill. Let No-Bake Matcha Pistachio Bliss Balls cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 10 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.creatorSecret: Use room-temperature dairy and eggs for No-Bake Matcha Pistachio Bliss Balls, and pull it from the oven when the edges are set and a toothpick has moist crumbs—overbaking dries it out.

steps.title: Bake No-Bake Matcha Pistachio Bliss Balls & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 4 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer No-Bake Matcha Pistachio Bliss Balls to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 10 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 130 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
